caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile, possibly a handkerchief or scarf, laid out flat with a slight fold visible at the upper left edge. The textile is primarily red, but features a large corner section of a lighter beige or tan color decorated with scalloped edges. Over this lighter section, there are black floral patterns, including clusters of flowers and leaves, placed prominently in the upper left and lower left areas of the beige panel, as well as a smaller grouping in the lower right. The textile has a slightly frayed bottom edge, and it is set against a plain, off-white background. In the lower left corner, the name "J V LUBRANO" is printed or written in uppercase letters.
title: Printed Textile
